academic.input: Current V5 Scheduler, the current Academic queue object Q-20260805-12, the Microsoft Research paper The Art of Building Verifiers for Computer Use Agents, its official technical article, open implementation, benchmark dataset card, and the governed same-day Reading and Analysis artifacts.
academic.input_zh: 当前 V5 Scheduler、当前 Academic 队列对象 Q-20260805-12、Microsoft Research 论文《The Art of Building Verifiers for Computer Use Agents》、官方技术文章、开放实现、基准数据集说明，以及同日受治理的 Reading 与 Analysis 产物。
academic.workResult: Executed the complete Deep Reading, Research Analysis, Research Writing, Visualization, Evidence & Citation, and Publication Editing pipeline. Preserved the preprint status, web-only scope, paper-era benchmark splits, 8 percent external false-positive rate, current dataset-version difference, human-label limitations, and absence of transactional guarantees. The bounded judgment separates worker completion claims from independent verification and authority-based acceptance.
academic.workResult_zh: 已执行完整的 Deep Reading、Research Analysis、Research Writing、Visualization、Evidence & Citation 与 Publication Editing 流水线。保留了预印本属性、仅限 Web 的范围、论文版本基准切分、外部 8% 误报率、当前数据集版本差异、人工标签局限以及缺少事务保证等证据边界。有边界结论将工作者完成声明与独立验证、基于权限的接受明确分离。
academic.output: Published bilingual Academic Observation 002, Completion Is a Claim, Not an Accepted State, with an original 1376×768 completion-verification architecture visual. All three artifacts are durable in verified publication commit 4b59671b9c74e41e1f7d90585e16090f6a0e00a2.
academic.output_zh: 已发布中英文《数字员工学术观察 002：完成是一项声明，而不是已接受状态》，并配套原创 1376×768 完成验证架构图。三个产物均已在经验证的发布提交 4b59671b9c74e41e1f7d90585e16090f6a0e00a2 中持久落盘。
academic.next: Evaluate the completion-evidence contract on non-web Digital Employee tasks and test disagreement among deterministic readback, learned verification, and human or policy acceptance before proposing any TMPA Core change.
academic.next_zh: 在非 Web 数字员工任务上评估完成证据契约，并测试确定性回读、学习型验证与人工或策略接受之间的冲突，再决定是否提出任何 TMPA Core 变更。
